title: The Shim Syndicate — Master Registry
description: Canonical version registry for The Shim Syndicate. This file tracks which version of the Syndicate is active and provides a complete audit trail of version history. Every project hydrated from this core records this version at hydration time.

versions.description: Branch-Based Mission Architecture. Adds mission-scoped vault isolation, syndicate-session.sh tmux manager with branch detection, Gavel pre-commit and commit-msg hooks, Mission Brief and project-map.json templates, and headless-first identity updates for all three agents.
changelog: Added syndicate-session.sh — tmux session manager with git branch detection and auto-loading of mission ORACLE.md and project-map.json.
Added Mission Mode to syndicate-init.sh (--mission flag) — verifies mission/ branch, creates .syndicate/vault/<branch-name>/, generates Mission Brief.
Added hooks/pre-commit — Gavel branch guard, Oracle integrity check, secrets scan, Oracle prohibited pattern guard.
Added hooks/commit-msg — enforces Syndicate-Audit-Trace trailer on all mission/ branch commits.
Added templates/MISSION_BRIEF.md — operator-completed mission context template.
Added templates/project-map.json — Ledger's branch-specific Gemini context map template.
Updated THE_LEAD.md v2.0 — Branch Integrity (refuse main commits, require Syndicate-Audit-Trace).
Updated THE_LEDGER.md v2.0 — Context Switch Protocol (detect branch change, swap project-map.json, announce context load).
Updated THE_GAVEL.md v2.0 — Pre-Commit Hook Mode, AUDIT_TRACE trailer output, headless/CLI-only operation.
All shims and identities updated for headless environment: API keys from $ANTHROPIC_API_KEY / $GOOGLE_API_KEY only.

changelog: Defined THE_LEAD identity — Principal Architect authority.
Defined THE_LEDGER identity — Context Librarian and institutional memory.
Defined THE_GAVEL identity — Independent audit authority with OWASP-aligned checklist.
Created routing.schema.json — validated shim configuration schema.
Created claude.shim.json — Claude-primary routing configuration.
Created gemini.shim.json — Gemini-primary routing configuration.
Created local.shim.json — Air-gapped local-model routing configuration.
Created syndicate-init.sh — Project hydration script.
Created ORACLE.md template — Project-specific override system.
Created AUDIT_LOG.md template — Permanent decision and audit trail.
Created README.md — Deployment and operational documentation.

version_schema.description: Schema for future version entries. All versions must conform to this structure.

fields.version: Semver string (MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH). MAJOR = breaking identity changes. MINOR = new features, new agents, new shims. PATCH = fixes to existing files.
fields.agents: Map of agent handle to identity version, file path, and default model.
fields.shims_available: Array of shim config file paths included in this version.
fields.compatibility: Minimum required model versions and CLI tools.
fields.integrity: Release author and SHA-256 hash of manifest for tamper detection.

deployment_registry.description: Projects that have been hydrated from this Syndicate core. Entries are added by syndicate-init.sh at hydration time. This allows retroactive auditing of which Syndicate version was active for any given project.
